result.instructions: Tools for Thinkific, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which courses on our Thinkific site have the most enrollments?"; "Enroll this learner in the onboarding course and set access to end in 90 days."; "Show all orders from this customer in the last 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Thinkific data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run thinkific_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run thinkific_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run thinkific_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. thinkific_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: thinkific_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the courses on the Thinkific site with id, name, status and price. Good first call to find a course_id for enrollments. Thinkific API: GET /courses.

tools.name: thinkific_get_course
tools.title: Get a course
tools.description: Get one course by id, including its name, description, status and pricing. Thinkific API: GET /courses/{id}.

tools.name: thinkific_list_enrollments
tools.title: List enrollments
tools.description: List course enrollments with progress and expiry, optionally filtered by course or learner. Thinkific API: GET /enrollments.

tools.name: thinkific_get_enrollment
tools.title: Get an enrollment
tools.description: Get one enrollment by id: the learner, the course, activation and expiry dates, and percentage completed. Thinkific API: GET /enrollments/{id}.

tools.name: thinkific_create_enrollment
tools.title: Enroll a learner in a course
tools.description: Enroll an existing learner in a course. This gives the learner access and can trigger Thinkific's enrollment emails. Use thinkific_list_users and thinkific_list_courses first to get the ids. Thinkific API: POST /enrollments.

activated_at.description: ISO 8601 start date of the access (optional).

expiry_date.description: ISO 8601 end date of the access (optional).

annotations.title: Enroll a learner in a course

tools.name: thinkific_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the learners and staff of the site, optionally filtered by email. Returns ids used by the enrollment tools. Thinkific API: GET /users.

email.description: Only users with this email address.

tools.name: thinkific_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one learner or staff user by id: name, email, roles and creation date. Thinkific API: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: thinkific_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: Create a learner account on the site with a name and email. Thinkific may send a welcome email. Check first with thinkific_list_users that the email is not already in use. Thinkific API: POST /users.

email.description: Email address of the new learner.

tools.name: thinkific_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (purchases) on the site, optionally for one learner. Shows what was bought, when and for how much. Thinkific API: GET /orders.

tools.name: thinkific_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id, with its items, amounts, currency and status. Thinkific API: GET /orders/{id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Thinkific
prompts.description: What you can do with Thinkific here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_courses_and_their_enrollments
prompts.title: Review courses and their enrollments
prompts.description: List the courses of the site and open one to read its status and description. List the enrollments of a course with progress and expiry.

prompts.name: check_one_learner_s_progress
prompts.title: Check one learner's progress
prompts.description: Find the learner by email, then list their enrollments. Open one enrollment to see its activation and expiry dates and percent completed.

prompts.name: review_the_orders_of_a_learner
prompts.title: Review the orders of a learner
prompts.description: Find the learner, list their orders, and open one order to see its items, amounts, currency and status.

prompts.name: enroll_a_learner_in_a_course
prompts.title: Enroll a learner in a course
prompts.description: Get the learner and course IDs, then enroll the learner. Enrollment gives access and can send Thinkific's enrollment emails.

prompts.name: create_a_learner_account
prompts.title: Create a learner account
prompts.description: Check that the email address is not in use yet, then create the learner account. Thinkific may send a welcome email.
